# Data Splits

Split files are generated by `scripts/generate_splits.py` from STEAD metadata.

**Do not edit these files manually.** They define the experiment reproducibility.

## Generation (on GPU server)

```bash
python scripts/generate_splits.py \
  --metadata-csv data/raw/metadata.csv \
  --output-dir data/splits \
  --seed 42
```

## Files

- `train.txt` — ~70% of event IDs
- `val.txt` — ~15% of event IDs
- `test.txt` — ~15% of event IDs

Each file contains one event ID per line.
